summary: Test-writing run for issue #39 (adopt generated OpenAPI client + solver parity corpus). Committed: (1) SolverParityCorpusTests — loads the WeightedSquaredError parity corpus (PARITY_CORPUS_PATH override -> canonical color_matching/priv/solver_parity_corpus.json -> committed Fixtures copy) and asserts scorer AND solver selections/scores/tie-flags/exclusion-counts match expected outputs exactly, ties included; (2) vendored 11-case corpus fixture whose every expectation was cross-checked against an independent reimplementation of the Elixir semantics (11/11 match, scores within 1e-9); (3) PaletteAPIClientContractTests pinning the /api/v1 wire contract the generated-client migration must keep; (4) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md (location + refresh). CAVEAT: no Swift toolchain exists in this container (`swift: command not found`), so `swift test` could not be executed here — bin/lint detects the missing toolchain and skips build/tests by design (exit 0). Swift files were hand-reviewed (access control, brace balance) and the JSON fixture validated with python3; they must be compiled/run on a Swift host in the review stage. Per-repo lint (conflict markers, whitespace) passed.
